ui.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
ui.faq.intro: Open each question to read the full answer. The answers describe general shopping-agent workflows; current platform rules should always be verified directly.
ui.faq.q1: Is this the official Sugargoo website?
ui.faq.a1: No. This is an independent guide and product-discovery website. It does not claim to be an official Sugargoo property.
ui.faq.a2: No. Product cards lead to the linked main shopping site. This guide site does not process orders or payments.
ui.faq.q3: How do I place an order?
ui.faq.a3: Open a product link, review the product information on the destination site, choose the required variation and follow that site’s checkout or agent-order instructions.
ui.faq.q4: Why should I check QC photos?
ui.faq.a4: QC photos show the item received by the warehouse and help you identify obvious variation, size, color or condition problems before international shipping.
ui.faq.a5: Delivery depends on the route, destination, customs, parcel type and seasonal congestion. Use the current route estimate as a range rather than a guaranteed date.
ui.faq.a6: Returns depend on the seller, platform policy and after-sales deadline. Request a return while the item is still in the warehouse whenever possible.
ui.faq.a7: Chargeable weight is the weight used for billing. It can be the parcel’s actual weight or its volumetric weight, depending on the route.
ui.faq.q8: What should I do before paying for shipping?
ui.faq.a8: Confirm the item list, QC results, address, declaration, packaging request, selected route, insurance option and estimated chargeable weight.

shop.catalogIntro: Browse the finds by category. Open an item to check the current seller listing, available options and details to verify when it reaches the warehouse.
shop.categoryIntro: Browse the {category} selection, compare the individual listings and read the checks below before choosing an option.
shop.categoriesIntro: Choose a category to see its finds and the measurements, photos or packing details that matter for those items.
shop.productIntro: Open the current seller listing to confirm the exact variant you want. The name on this page identifies the catalogue entry.
shop.checkBeforeBody: Match the seller, selected option, quantity and price to the purchase you intend to make. Save the option wording and any measurement that will affect your decision.
shop.checkAfterBody: Find the received item in Packing Center. Compare its reference and inspection photos with the order, and request a clearer view if a detail is uncertain.
shop.shippingBody: Use the packed dimensions, weight and product attributes to compare eligible services for your delivery address. Check the amount due before paying.
shop.sizing: For a tee or polo, compare the flat width from one underarm seam to the other and the length from shoulder to hem with a garment that already fits.
shop.ttitle: Sugargoo T-Shirt Spreadsheet UK – Tee & Polo Finds

categoryChecks.shoes: Compare the size system with the seller's chart. At the warehouse, check both shoes and both labels, then decide whether the original box is worth the extra packing space.
categoryChecks.hoodies-sweaters: Check flat chest width and sleeve length against a top you own. Distinguish hoodies from crewnecks and knitwear, and inspect cuffs, seams and the chosen colour.
categoryChecks.t-shirts: Compare flat chest width and body length. For a polo, check the collar and placket as well as the size label. For a printed tee, compare the position of the design with your selected option.
categoryChecks.jackets: Allow room for the layers you plan to wear. Compare chest width, sleeve length and closure details. Ask whether a bulky jacket can be packed more compactly without damaging its shape.
categoryChecks.pants-shorts: Check waist width, rise and inseam using the seller's measurement method. For shorts, use the finished length. Inspect drawstrings, fastenings and the selected wash or colour.
categoryChecks.headwear: Check the circumference range and the type of adjustment. Inspect the brim and crown in the warehouse photos and consider protective packing if the hat must hold its shape.
categoryChecks.accessories: Check the dimensions against the intended use and confirm what is included. In the photos, inspect visible closures, hardware and corners. Keep a protective box when the contents need it.
categoryChecks.electronics: Confirm the model, included accessories and any power or battery requirements with the seller. An exterior photo establishes visible condition only. Check shipping eligibility for the actual contents.

about: We publish an independent catalogue and practical guides for people ordering goods to the UK. Our product pages link to current listings. The warehouse checks and shipping examples help readers decide what to verify with their seller or agent.
contact: For a purchase, missing warehouse photos, payment or shipping issue, contact Sugargoo through its official support channel. Have your item or parcel reference ready and share private order details only within the official service. This guide cannot access customer orders.
privacy: This site uses Google Analytics 4 to measure visits, use of the homepage search and clicks that take visitors from the guide to the shopping catalogue. The site’s search-use event records the length of the enquiry. Opening an external listing takes you to a separate service with its own privacy practices.
disclaimer: Product availability, variants, carrier eligibility and prices can change after a guide is published. Examples illustrate how to check a decision. Verify the seller’s current offer and the terms shown for your parcel before paying.
